payload.definition: RF-Kumagai at the full budget (654 hosts) with the 10 entries with |defect moment| > 0.5 muB removed from training and test (pre-registered in config). delta = excluded-run MAE minus baseline MAE, paired over the same test hosts with identical bootstrap draws.
